quotes.text: “'Cause it begins at half-past one, the man says so.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “You can have your dinner as soon as it's done,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“You'll do nothing of the sort. It will be done in five minutes. It is
only half-past twelve.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Besides, it's only
half-past twelve, so you've a full hour.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Take your pudding in your hand--and it's only five past one, so you
were wrong--you haven't got your twopence,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “I want to go, I want to go,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Well, and you shall go, whining, wizzening little stick!”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“You never said you was coming--isn't the' a lot of things?--that lion's
killed three men--I've spent my tuppence--an' look here.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“I got these from that stall where y'ave ter get them marbles in
them holes. An' I got these two in two goes-'aepenny a go-they've got
moss-roses on, look here. I wanted these.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Shall you carry 'em, 'cause I'm frightened o' breakin' 'em?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Well, are you coming now, or later?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Already? It is past four, I know.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “You needn't come if you don't want,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown
